why: The whole of issue #223's awareness delay dies silently: `backdateHazards` returns the real world for every delay, so a tank's hazard picture is current to the tick again and the escape solve is the oracle the issue opens against. Nothing else can see it. `bot-difficulty.test.ts` still resolves the preset correctly, `hazard-competence.test.ts` still measures the radius error (untouched by this), and the golden trace CANNOT catch it either -- a build with a zero delay is exactly the neutrality point tools/baseline/trace.ts's re-pin was demonstrated at, so this mutation just moves BASELINE_HASH back to a value that was green three commits ago. The mutation is written as `>= 0` rather than by deleting the guard because the harness needs a non-empty replacement and an always-true guard is the more realistic shape of the regression -- someone loosening a condition, not removing a line. Killed by seven of the 22 tests in hazard-perception.test.ts, spanning three distinct claims: the four `backdateHazards` unit assertions, the pair that enters through greyDecision/tealDecision (so it is a DECISION change, not merely a data one), and the developer trace's own zero-divergence control.
